claim: The incident occurred at approximately 2:15 PM on September 14, 2026, in Aisle 4.
Two employees witnessed the incident.
Forklift unit FL-118 was operated by Dana Whitfield.
The forklift struck the end-cap of shelving unit 4-B while turning to exit the aisle.
Dana sustained a minor injury to the left hand.
The operator's forklift certification had lapsed the previous month and was pending renewal.
Dana Whitfield's title is listed as Warehouse Associate II, Logistics Department.
Marcus Ilunga is a Warehouse Associate on second shift, clocked in at 2:45 PM on September 14.
Priya Nair is the Inventory Coordinator and shift supervisor for Aisles 3-6, and was on duty at the time of the incident.
Dana states she completed recertification training in March.
Dana estimates the incident happened around 2:15 PM.
Marcus states the incident happened closer to 3:00 PM, right after shift change.
Marcus states the Aisle 4 guard rail had been loose for at least two weeks.
Marcus states he believes only himself and 'maybe one other person' clearly witnessed the event, and is not sure who else was around.
Marcus states the emergency alarm did not sound and someone had to run and get the floor supervisor.
Facilities re-tightened and inspected the Aisle 4 guard rail bracket on September 14 at 9:00 AM and confirmed it secure.
Cross-referenced records show Dana Whitfield's forklift certification was last renewed March 3, 2026, valid through March 3, 2027, with no lapses on file.
The HR Personnel File lists Dana Whitfield's title as Forklift Operator.
The HR Personnel File states certification status is current, renewed March 2026.
Safety Committee minutes dated September 9 flagged an open item about a loose guard rail bracket in Aisle 4, to be addressed by end of week.
R. Danvers states in an email that the emergency alarm sounded immediately and the aisle was cleared within a minute.
R. Danvers states three people were on the floor near Aisle 4 at the time: Dana, Marcus, and Priya.
J. Okafor states in a reply email that the alarm did NOT sound and someone had to go get Priya in person.
The investigation status section restates: incident approximately 2:15 PM, Aisle 4, forklift FL-118, operated by Dana Whitfield (Warehouse Associate II), two witnesses present.
